verdict.rationale: Cursor's security page states that accounts can be deleted at any time from the Settings dashboard, which gives users a coarse deletion control. Privacy Mode, which admins can enforce team-wide, only promises no training on user data and does not state retention terms. Nothing in the pack is specific to Bugbot's handling of PR code or review data. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods, Bugbot-specific data retention/deletion documentation, deletion of specific review or code data beyond whole-account deletion, explicit zero-retention guarantees, independent corroboration.
